snippet.title: The Last Caretaker - Official Pre-Release Accolades Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Pre-Release Accolades Trailer for The Last Care Taker, an action-adventure survival shooter developed by Channel37 Ltd. Players will craft, explore, and fight off rogue machines across a vast ocean in the ultimate quest to bring about humanity's rebirth. The Last Caretaker is coming soon to PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) in Early Access.
